title: The Blackwood Masquerade
description: An invitation to the annual masked ball at Blackwood Manor seemed like an honour — until the clock struck midnight and a body was discovered in the locked study. The doors are sealed, the guests are restless, and the killer is still wearing a mask. Everyone has a secret. Only one has blood on their hands.

characters.name: Lord Blackwood
characters.description: The wealthy owner of the Blackwood estate. Charming on the surface, but rumoured to have dark secrets.

characters.name: Lady Evelyn Cross
characters.description: An aristocrat known for her sharp wit and sharper grudges. Was seen arguing with the victim earlier that evening.

characters.name: Inspector Hargrove
characters.description: The seasoned detective called to the scene. He reveals clues but keeps his conclusions to himself.

chapters.title: The Ball Begins
chapters.narrative: Guests arrive at the dimly lit Blackwood mansion. Laughter fills the air, but something feels off.

chapters.title: A Scream in the Dark
chapters.narrative: The clock strikes midnight. A scream echoes from the east wing. When the candles are relit, the victim is found.

chapters.title: Interrogations
chapters.narrative: Inspector Hargrove questions each guest one by one. Contradictions surface. Alibis crumble.

title: The 8:15 to Vienna
description: The overnight express from Paris to Vienna is no stranger to secrets — but tonight it carries something darker. A passenger is found dead in a locked compartment somewhere past the Swiss border. The train cannot stop. The killer cannot escape. And as the hours tick by, every alibi begins to unravel.

characters.name: Madame Voss
characters.description: A retired opera singer travelling alone. She claims she heard nothing.

characters.name: Dr. Emil Rast
characters.description: A physician with a nervous disposition. He was the first to declare the victim dead.

characters.name: The Conductor
characters.description: Responsible for the entire train. He insists no one boarded or left since departure.

chapters.title: All Aboard
chapters.narrative: The 8:15 departs under a grey sky. Passengers settle in, unaware not everyone will reach the final destination.

chapters.title: The Locked Compartment
chapters.narrative: A porter notices the compartment has been locked for hours. When forced open, a grim discovery awaits.

chapters.title: Nowhere to Run
chapters.narrative: With the train still moving and the killer among them, passengers grow suspicious of one another.

title: The Last Exhibit
description: The grand reopening of the Havelock Museum was meant to be a celebration — a night of champagne, ancient artefacts, and press photographers. But when the lights cut out during the unveiling of a priceless Roman dagger, the curator is found dead beside the empty display case. The weapon is missing. The murderer is among the guests. And the museum's cameras have been disabled.

characters.name: Director Havelock
characters.description: The ambitious museum director who staked his reputation on tonight's exhibit. He seems more shaken by the missing dagger than by the body.

characters.name: Clara Venn
characters.description: A sharp-eyed reporter who arrived early and stayed late. She was seen near the exhibit room just before the lights went out.

characters.name: Otto Braun
characters.description: The museum's head of security. He claims he was doing rounds on the ground floor all evening — but no one can confirm it.

characters.name: Detective Serrano
characters.description: Called in from the city precinct, Serrano is methodical and calm. She trusts evidence over instinct.

chapters.title: Opening Night
chapters.narrative: Guests mingle beneath ancient artefacts. The mood is celebratory — but one attendee has very different plans for the evening.

chapters.title: Lights Out
chapters.narrative: The unveiling begins. The room goes dark. When power is restored, the dagger is gone and the curator is on the floor.

chapters.title: The Empty Case
chapters.narrative: Detective Serrano seals the museum and begins her interviews. Every suspect has a motive. None have a clean alibi.
